question.knowledge_point: Finding the Amplitude-Phase Form for Sine
question.worked_solution:
The sum formula for sine gives

$$
\begin{aligned}R\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+ϕ) & =R(\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡ϕ+\operatorname{cos}⁡x\operatorname{sin}⁡ϕ) \\  & =R\operatorname{cos}⁡ϕ\operatorname{sin}⁡x+R\operatorname{sin}⁡ϕ\operatorname{cos}⁡x.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, by writing the given expression in the amplitude-phase form

$$
\sqrt{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡x+2\operatorname{cos}⁡x=R\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+ϕ),
$$

we get the following identity:

$$
\sqrt{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡x+2\operatorname{cos}⁡x=(R\operatorname{cos}⁡ϕ)\operatorname{sin}⁡x+(R\operatorname{sin}⁡ϕ)\operatorname{cos}⁡x
$$

Equating the coefficients of $\operatorname{sin}⁡x$ and $\operatorname{cos}⁡x,$ we get the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}R\operatorname{cos}⁡ϕ=\sqrt{5} \\ R\operatorname{sin}⁡ϕ=2\end{aligned}
$$

Dividing the second equation by the first, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{R\operatorname{sin}⁡ϕ}{R\operatorname{cos}⁡ϕ} & =\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}} \\ \operatorname{tan}⁡ϕ & =\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{5} \\ ϕ & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{5}) \\ ϕ & ≈0.730\,\text{rad}\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to three decimal places.

Now, we find the amplitude $R.$ Squaring the first and the second equations of the system and adding the results together, we get: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{R}^{2}{cos}^{2}⁡ϕ+{R}^{2}{sin}^{2}⁡ϕ & =(\sqrt{5})^{2}+{2}^{2} \\ {R}^{2}({cos}^{2}⁡ϕ+{sin}^{2}⁡ϕ) & =5+4 \\ {R}^{2} & =9 \\ R & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Note that we only consider the positive root since $R>0.$

Finally, we can write the initial expression in amplitude-phase form as follows:

$$
\sqrt{5}\operatorname{sin}⁡x+2\operatorname{cos}⁡x≈3\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+0.730)
$$

For q-80135, coefficient matching gives R cos(phi)=R sin(phi)=5, hence tan(phi)=1 and phi=45 degrees in the required interval. For q-107574, R=sqrt(5+4)=3 and phi=arctan(2/sqrt(5)), approximately 0.730 radians, giving the stated approximate amplitude-phase form. No grade evidence was supplied.
